To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most important aspects for the development of intelligent algorithms are the memory, computational, and energy requirements, and that the best algorithms are those with the lowest requirements.
the most important factors to consider when choosing a machine learning algorithm to implement on a resource constrained platform are memory and computational requirements.

the best algorithms for space systems should have the following characteristics: 1) They should be able to run in a distributed environment. 2) They should have minimal memory requirements. 3) They should be easily portable to a variety of platforms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the best algorithms to implement in space, and then finding the most suitable platforms on which to implement these algorithms.
the development of a set of algorithms which may be used for intelligent system optimization and control.
identifying and developing the next generation of algorithms which can be deployed onto resource constrained systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a great deal of potential in this field, but that there is a significant amount of research and development required in order to realize that potential.
the state of the art of AI and machine learning is still in its infancy and that the future holds much promise for its application in space and terrestrial systems.

there is no one size fits all approach to machine learning and optimization for space applications, and that the best approach will depend on the specific application, as well as the specific platform.

we have identified a set of algorithms that are feasible to implement directly onto space systems with reduced processing requirements.
there are many algorithms which are suitable for implementation on resource constrained devices.

the use of machine learning and optimization techniques can greatly benefit future space and ground based communication systems.
